# Read-only case fixtures

These snapshots are actual saved outputs of the offline confirmation cross-CLI
and model fake-driver protocol exercises. They are synthetic/hypothetical evidence,
not new device captures or verified optimization. Primary and arm JSON bytes are
copied without rewriting declarations. The added case_context.json labels the
fixture scope only; it cannot grant provenance or qualification.

Confirmation origin: phonefarm-confirmation-observation/tasks/confirmation_observation_20261011/cross_cli.
Model origin: game-loop-model-artifact-pipeline/tasks/model_pipeline_20261011/demo_final.
Original absolute model associations intentionally remain outside this fixture root
and must be reported unavailable. Tests may relocate a copied journal's declarations
explicitly as a contract mutation, never claim those bytes are original producer output.
